name: Papers
description: One row per practice paper plan or completed-paper analysis — focus topics, linked mistakes, difficulty mix, items, and (once analyzed) wrong-question count/strengths/review plan. Written by scripts/record_homework.mjs; export to a real file happens outside this app after parent/teacher approval

agentPrompts.label: Build a practice paper plan
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-homework-coach` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then plan a practice paper for the subject/topic/grade I give — title, question count, estimated minutes, difficulty mix, and linked mistakes to focus on. This is a plan only; export happens locally outside this app after parent/teacher approval.

agentPrompts.label: Analyze a completed paper
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-homework-coach` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then record the analysis for the paper I name after it was completed — wrong-question count, strengths, concept gaps, and a recommended review sequence.

agentPrompts.label: What's in this paper?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-homework-coach` skill in this folder, then show me the paper I name — its focus topics, linked mistakes, difficulty mix, and items, plus its analysis if one exists.
